metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for AI task management, safety guard hooks, and UE5 material authoring

plugins.name: taskmaster
plugins.description: Universal AI-powered task and backlog management with narrative continuity: handovers, issues, areas, finite epics (done_when). As of 6.0.0 a SQLite store (.taskmaster/local/store.db) is the runtime authority; backlog.yaml and the per-entity markdown files are a Git-facing projection, so concurrent agents no longer overwrite each other's writes. Existing v2/v3/v4 backlogs are adopted on first open (first open of a large backlog takes minutes). Kanban viewer with inline edit-in-UI served at the root URL for every project. Lessons subsystem removed in 4.0 (durable knowledge lives in assistant memory + CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md). Requires: uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: Safety guard hooks that block destructive CLI commands and sensitive file edits, with user-approval override flow via AskUserQuestion. Pure-Python hooks (3.9+), no jq required.

plugins.name: ue5-materials
plugins.description: Author UE5 materials from YAML. Live mode drives the Material Editor via MCPBridge (localhost:13580); clipboard mode emits T3D paste text. HLSL Architect (Opus) + Node Generator (Sonnet) agent chain for complex designs, direct YAML for simple wiring. Requires: pyyaml.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Pastel statusline for Claude Code with rate-limit bars, git status, context usage, update notifications, and session cost. Bash + PowerShell. Self-healing resolver survives plugin updates. Run /statusline:custom-statusline-install after install. Requires: jq (Bash only).

plugins.name: reflect-auto-improve
plugins.description: Reflect on past work and propose concrete improvements. Time-windowed project retros, pain-point harvesting into workflow drafts, and claude-tools plugin self-audits. Outputs route through taskmaster as ideas and issues.

plugins.name: feedback-inbox
plugins.description: Live feedback channel from any Claude instance back to the claude-tools toolmaker. Producer skill writes tagged messages to a configurable inbox; /inbox triage walks pending messages and routes accepted ones to taskmaster:add-idea or taskmaster:bug. Run /feedback-inbox-setup once per machine.

plugins.name: agent-relay
plugins.description: Explicit, local-first direct and group communication between selected Codex and Claude Code CLI sessions, with direct messages, review requests, replies, and rooms.
